{{Quote|This planet&mdash;''Oznek''&mdash;is key to the Republic holding this sector. Unfortunately, the Seps have figured this out too and are moving their forces in ''en masse''. It wouldn't be so much of a problem if the ''locals'' here would lend a hand in throwing the droids off, but so far they're claiming neutrality&hellip; they ''say'' they don't want to get involved with the war.|[[Griebs Kishpaugh]]|<ref name="TEW" />}}
'''Oznek''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
{{Quote|Even though you were acting under orders, your maneuvers jeopardized the Republic's standing on Oznek. Perhaps ''permanently''.|A [[Republic officer/Legends|Republic officer]], to Banks|<ref name="TEW" />}}
Oznek was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Toma]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Oznek was the site of a supposed [[Oznek power plant|droid command center]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent a [[Banks's squadron|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to [[Mission to Oznek|destroy]] the command center, led by [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]]. When [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Griebs Kishpaugh]] attempted to subvert the mission through his agent, the clone trooper [[Ghost (clone trooper)|Ghost]], Banks stopped the plot.
